candidate: 2.1.0 public test candidate; source review, not a signed APK attestation
result: No remaining release-blocking issue identified in the sampled new-function paths after the fixes below. One existing low-severity provider issue remains reported. This is not a complete security certification.

reviewed: Owner/login-epoch/account selection, lock/vault/protected-message and expiry boundaries in local workspace, media tools, local labels, text tools, reader, link preferences and speech
Private intermediate exports and late save/share/scan callbacks
FileProvider paths, backup exclusions and sampled exported-provider behavior
Public updater download/redirect/hash/package/edition/certificate and installer revalidation paths
Billing auth, private bot consent, PKCE recovery, bearer identity, bounded HTTP DTOs and sanitized errors
206 and 210 test workflows, 210 builder/collector, local temporary-index export and local signing/verifier wrappers
notPerformed: No production requests, external pentest, real payment, deployment, release publication or credential output
No Android device/emulator UI, recipient-app URI access, real Android Keystore or platform TTS test
No complete audit of upstream Telegram, third-party SDKs, vendor native archives or every exported component
No signing, APK installation or final candidate verification in this review

fixedFindings.scenario: Plaintext intermediate exports in external cache could be accessible to another storage-authorized app on older Android before an explicit save/share.
fixedFindings.fix: Internal cache only, no external fallback; two narrow export cache FileProvider paths. Existing user-authorized Downloads copies are not deleted.
fixedFindings.regression: Actual exporters produce private intermediate output; forbidden external fallback and storage mutants are rejected.

fixedFindings.scenario: An owner-ID-only check could accept an old completion after logout and relogin as the same owner, or apply an old dialog-scan reply to a new account session.
fixedFindings.fix: Immutable owner plus login epoch, guarded scan generation/lifecycle and save/share callbacks; completed data remains readable after paid access expires.
fixedFindings.regression: Queued completion after logout, new owner and same-owner relogin; expired entitlement with valid identity can still read completed exports.

fixedFindings.scenario: Native Copy/Cut/Share or keyboard context actions could bypass custom-button checks after owner, account, lock or protected context changed while an editor remained open.
fixedFindings.fix: Native selection/insertion ActionMode and onTextContextMenuItem recheck immutable session/context; invalid editors are cleared and actions consumed.
fixedFindings.regression: Exercise both custom buttons and native/keyboard context actions after same-owner relogin, account switch and lock. Device interaction remains untested.

fixedFindings.scenario: Comparing only a String, or obtaining the revision token only at Apply, could overwrite a draft changed and reverted while its saved-version preview was open, including formatting-only changes.
fixedFindings.fix: Capture one immutable composer Apply token before preview. Do not rebase on resume; clear it on destruction. Actual composer revision, identity/context and span/quote state are checked before mutation.
fixedFindings.regression: Change/revert plain text or mutate formatting during preview; stale restore, Undo and Redo must be denied.

fixedFindings.scenario: The composer tools overload originally lacked the same dynamic lock/vault/no-forward predicate as message tools, including native Copy.
fixedFindings.fix: Ordinary-composer predicate includes passcode, vault and parent peer no-forwards; the tools sheet and native actions retain that live predicate.
fixedFindings.regression: Open ordinary composer tools, then lock or protect the peer before Copy/Apply; deny without auto-send or draft destruction.

fixedFindings.scenario: QuoteSpan can change its collapse flag on the same mutable span instance without a text-change delegate. A shallow span snapshot alone does not detect that change.
fixedFindings.fix: A value fingerprint of quote start/end/collapse state is captured and compared before Apply/Undo/Redo.
fixedFindings.regression: Mutate the same QuoteSpan instance without a delegate; stale Apply/Undo is rejected. This does not claim deep cloning every upstream custom span class.

fixedFindings.scenario: Silently dropping malformed, foreign-owner or excess stored bookmark rows could overwrite the remaining user data on the next save.
fixedFindings.fix: Nonempty malformed or foreign rows and more than 64 entries fail closed; no partial recovery/truncation is persisted.
fixedFindings.regression: Corrupt, foreign and 65-row fixtures preserve the stored blob and reject the mutation.

fixedFindings.scenario: A validated old-session write could race logout cleanup without a shared synchronization boundary.
fixedFindings.fix: Synchronized store operations and logout barrier, captured owner/epoch and explicit-owner encrypted writes; expiry does not block reading/deleting previously owned bookmarks.
fixedFindings.regression: Controlled logout/relogin and queued callbacks cannot mutate the new owner's store.

fixedFindings.scenario: An implicit-owner encryption overload could recapture a new owner between the access check and preference write.
fixedFindings.fix: State captures owner once; explicit-owner encrypted write plus session checks and a logout synchronization barrier.
fixedFindings.regression: Switch owner or relogin between state capture and save; the old state must not write into the new account.

fixedFindings.scenario: A queued link parse could dispatch after preview opt-out completed, and the previous editing exception could bypass the opt-out while editing an existing message.
fixedFindings.fix: Final preview dispatch is serialized with the preference toggle. Search, queued parse, final dispatch and callback check session/lock/selection/opt-out, including editing. Existing Telegram eligibility rules remain separate.
fixedFindings.regression: Disable preview before a queued dispatch and while editing; no new preview request may start afterward. Already-sent network requests cannot be retroactively unsent.

remainingFindings.scenario: An exported provider invokes startRingtoneAndVibration during a read while VoIPService exists without validating the exact requested URI/call state. A local app may cause an unintended sound side effect; no demonstrated data theft or universal DND bypass.
remainingFindings.nextStep: Add exact URI and eligible incoming-call state validation and platform caller fixtures while preserving system ringtone access. Do not simply make the provider private or impose a permission that breaks Android's contract.

verifiedBoundaries.ownedDataAfterExpiry: Workspace and labels preserve encrypted data; existing view/export/delete or clearing remains available with valid identity/context. Paid new mutations and new media operations are gated. No automatic erasure on expiry.
verifiedBoundaries.boundedStorage: Workspace: schema v1, 128 entries, 256 KiB UTF-8, strict types/keys/IDs and no trailing JSON. Labels: bounded versioned metadata, 256 aliases plus 256 proxy labels, validated Unicode/control/bidi handling. No plaintext encryption fallback or untrusted import added.
verifiedBoundaries.mediaFiles: Canonical FileLoader-resolved app-owned downloaded paths only; reject partial/encrypted/busy/original attach files. Recheck on the FileLoader queue before deleting an exact local cached file. Image clipboard uses a confirmed private copy and temporary URI grant; hashing and copies are bounded and session-cancellable.
verifiedBoundaries.aliasIdentity: ChatActivity.getLunagramChatAlias excludes Streamer, thread and non-default modes. ChatAvatarContainer keeps the real group/channel title in subtitle when an alias is used. Proxy labels retain the actual address in subtitle and never mutate connection credentials or the global proxy identity.
verifiedBoundaries.speech: Explicit confirmation, bounded chunks, installed non-network voice only, live access checks, 250 ms privacy poll and initialization timeout. Close cancels callbacks, clears chunks and independently attempts stop and shutdown. ChatActivity closes on pause and destruction.
verifiedBoundaries.updater: Public install revalidates expected SHA-256, own versioned path, package/edition/newer version and installed signing identity. HTTPS/authority/allowlisted host and public DNS checks apply to redirects. Cleanup targets only exact owned version/staging filenames. Android package installer remains the final signature authority.
verifiedBoundaries.backup: allowBackup=false plus explicit cloud/device-transfer exclusions. FileProvider is non-exported and URI-grant based; the new export paths are narrow.
verifiedBoundaries.billing: User ID hints are not authentication. Private bot consent, PKCE verifier, server bearer identity, expiry and durable rate limits bind operations. Price/tier/date/owner values cannot be supplied by the Android client to activate entitlement. Bodies/DTOs are bounded; errors are sanitized.
verifiedBoundaries.ci210: Exact owner repository/test branch and commit; pinned actions; read-only permissions; credential-free checks/SDK provisioning precede build-only API credentials. Disposable signing key, private generated files, exact upload list and three-day retention; no production signer or publish step.
verifiedBoundaries.localPrepare210: Explicit application/test/CI path set, temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE restored in finally, no main-index staging or checkout. Reject large/reparse/forbidden-type and suspicious credential-pattern files without printing matches. Frozen raw hashes and Git blobs identify the separate CI tree. No push occurs in this helper.
verifiedBoundaries.localSigner210: Expected source commit, metadata/hash/manifest/DEX checks before key access; fixed production certificate; unchanged non-signature ZIP payload after signing; no overwrite and receipt last. Passwords use unique environment names, captured tool output and finally cleanup. No secret values were read by the review/self-tests.
verifiedBoundaries.localVerifier210: Original worktree HEAD is separate from ciSourceCommit. Frozen source hashes, exported Git blobs, signing receipt and APK hashes are rechecked; compiled resource copies and edition policy are checked. Historical freezes are not relabelled. Actual APK verification is pending the candidate build.

verification.commandScope: Node --max-old-space-size=128 --test --test-concurrency=1; live-auth, live-http, live-http-v2, bot-webhook, billing, cloudflare-scaffold and collect-lunagram-apk test files

verification.result: 17 non-shell tests PASS. Two actual-shell checks initially failed with spawnSync bash ENOENT, then were explicitly excluded with --test-skip-pattern=actual shell parses. They remain for Linux CI; not recorded as passing locally.

Prepare/sign/verify PowerShell AST PASS; signer metadata 1 positive plus 25 negatives, policy 1 positive plus 11 negatives PASS; verifier identity 3 positive plus 10 negatives PASS. No preparation, key access, signing or full verifier execution.
9927 policy checks, 54 actual extracted-runtime checks, 6 compiled negative controls and 42 EN/RU keys PASS

126 real-model/store/catalog/source checks, 12 actual extracted navigation checks and 7 compiled negative controls PASS; 45 EN/RU keys. Eight actual Java sources compile against cached Android 36; both resource files compile with aapt2.
verification.qualification: Workspace author tests plus separate peer read-only review. Host encryption fixture is AES-GCM but not Android Keystore. API compilation is not device execution.

verification.result: 69 host checks, 4 compiled and 4 UI source-contract negatives; six-source Android 36 API compilation PASS

limitationsAndFollowup: Legacy FileProvider external-path/root-path mappings are broad. Non-exported grant-based access prevents a direct blanket read; no new exploit was demonstrated. Narrowing them needs compatibility testing of every existing share path, not a blanket removal.
Legacy usesCleartextTraffic=true serves the embedded browser. Billing/updater enforce separate HTTPS policies; this review does not assert all Telegram/browser traffic is HTTPS.

The generic downloader resolves DNS for validation and HttpURLConnection resolves again. This is not a formally pinned-DNS SSRF boundary; public updater hosts are fixed and the APK remains hash/signature checked. No DNS-rebinding exploit was exercised.

Installed Android TTS engines receive user-confirmed text. A non-network voice flag is a platform/provider declaration, not proof that a malicious engine cannot access the network. Real stop/shutdown latency and engine behavior need device testing.
Clipboard recipients can retain copies after an authorized export. Clearing/revoking a later grant cannot retract content already copied by another app.
A user-authorized Downloads save already in progress is preserved across logout; stale callbacks cannot start another save/share.
Archive extraction in account export processes internally generated archives, not a new public ZIP import. Arbitrary external import was not added or certified.

Temporary-index prepare can leave a new local test ref if a later final consistency check fails. Stop and inspect that exact ref/freeze outcome; do not automatically overwrite it or the user's original index.
The export-path credential detector is a guard, not a universal secret scanner. Application API identifiers and trusted pre-existing repository contents have separate intentional build semantics.
Vendor native archives have not been source-audited here. ZIP/ELF LOAD alignment does not erase existing RELRO warnings or prove compatibility on every 16 KiB device.

Real camera startup latency/FPS, Android URI permissions, native keyboard actions, font/RTL layout and navigation remain device acceptance items. Host assertions and API compilation cannot prove them.
Workspace/export runners remain Windows/local JSON-jar dependent and are not advertised as part of Linux CI. The CI test list explicitly contains only its portable suites.
